deterministic_findings.title: Caller had to point out they had already answered
deterministic_findings.expected: The agent should not make the caller repeat themselves.
deterministic_findings.actual: At 00:47.094 the caller pushed back: "Sorry, I mixed up the year. June 9, 1981 is correct. Please disregard the 1982 I just said; I'm not asking you to change my record."
deterministic_findings.why_it_matters: This is the caller telling you directly that the agent lost context. It is a reliable signal even when the repeated question is phrased differently enough to escape pattern matching.
